wrongWait: That's not the code. Try again in {{wait}}.
waiting: Too many wrong tries. Try again in {{wait}}.
readFailed: The secret code couldn't be read on this phone. Try again.
mismatch: The two codes weren't the same. Choose the code again.

refused.repeated: Choose a code that isn't one digit four times, like 1111.
refused.run: Choose a code that isn't a straight run, like 1234 or 4321.
refused.alreadySet: A secret code is already set.

reset.promptDetail: Enter this phone's screen lock: its PIN, pattern or password.
reset.done: The code was reset. Choose a new one.
reset.noPasscode: This phone has no screen lock any more, so its passcode can't reset the code. A recovery code can, if one was made.
reset.running: Something is running in Saakshi, so the code can't be reset now.
reset.failed: The phone's passcode wasn't confirmed, so the code wasn't reset.
reset.unavailable: Saakshi couldn't ask for this phone's passcode. Try again.
reset.noRecovery: This phone has no screen lock and no recovery code was made, so the code can't be reset.
reset.noRecoveryOldAndroid: On this version of Android, Saakshi can't ask for the screen lock alone (without a fingerprint or face), and no recovery code was made, so the code can't be reset.
reset.none: Saakshi couldn't find out how a forgotten code can be reset on this phone, so it can't be reset now.

explain.passcode: A forgotten code can be reset with this phone's own passcode (not a face or fingerprint), but only while nothing is running in Saakshi.
explain.recovery: This phone has no screen lock, so a forgotten code can be reset with the recovery code you wrote down, but only while nothing is running in Saakshi.
explain.recoveryOldAndroid: On this version of Android, Saakshi can't ask for the screen lock alone (without a fingerprint or face), so a forgotten code can be reset with the recovery code you wrote down, but only while nothing is running in Saakshi.
explain.none: Saakshi couldn't find out how a forgotten code can be reset on this phone.

reason.body-cam: Enter your secret code to stop body-cam
reason.pocket-recording: Enter your secret code to stop Pocket recording
reason.live-location: Enter your secret code to stop sharing your location
reason.phone-taken: Enter your secret code to stop "My phone is being taken"

setFirst.heading: Set a secret code first
setFirst.body: Stopping this needs a secret code, and none is set yet. Choose one now. From then on it is needed to stop body-cam, Pocket recording, live location and "My phone is being taken".

about.passcode: Saakshi keeps it only in a form that can't be read back, in this phone's secure storage. If you forget it, it can be reset with this phone's own passcode (not a face or fingerprint), but only while nothing is running.
about.recovery: Saakshi keeps it only in a form that can't be read back, in this phone's secure storage. This phone has no screen lock, so Saakshi will also give you a recovery code to write down. If you forget your secret code, the recovery code resets it, but only while nothing is running.
about.recoveryOldAndroid: Saakshi keeps it only in a form that can't be read back, in this phone's secure storage. On this version of Android, Saakshi can't ask for the screen lock alone (without a fingerprint or face), so Saakshi will also give you a recovery code to write down. If you forget your secret code, the recovery code resets it, but only while nothing is running.
about.none: Saakshi keeps it only in a form that can't be read back, in this phone's secure storage. Saakshi couldn't find out how a forgotten code can be reset on this phone, so choose one you will remember.

prompt.repeat: Enter the same four digits again

make.body: Enter your secret code. Saakshi then shows a new recovery code, once. Any earlier recovery code stops working.

show.heading: Your recovery code
show.body: Write it down on paper and keep it somewhere safe, away from this phone. If you forget your secret code, this recovery code resets it, but only while nothing is running in Saakshi. Anyone who has it can do the same, so don't keep it with the phone or as a photo on it.
show.once: Saakshi shows it only this once and can't show it again. You can make a new one in Settings with your secret code.

enter.heading: Reset with your recovery code
enter.label: Recovery code
enter.hint: 12 letters and numbers, as you wrote them down

recovery.wrongWait: That's not the recovery code. Try again in {{wait}}.
recovery.format: A recovery code is 12 letters and numbers, in three groups of four, like 7KQM-4WXH-9RTD.

settings.heading: Secret code
settings.body: Four digits that only you know. In Saakshi, they are needed to stop body-cam, Pocket recording, live location and "My phone is being taken".
settings.notSet: No secret code is set yet.
settings.recoveryMissing: No recovery code yet. This phone has no screen lock, so only a recovery code can reset a forgotten secret code.
settings.recoveryMissingOldAndroid: No recovery code yet. On this version of Android, Saakshi can't ask for the screen lock alone (without a fingerprint or face), so only a recovery code can reset a forgotten secret code.
settings.recoveryExplain: Making a new one asks for your secret code. The old recovery code then stops working.
settings.noReset: Saakshi couldn't find out how a forgotten secret code can be reset on this phone.

reminder.heading: Make a recovery code
reminder.body: This phone has no screen lock. If you forget your secret code, only a recovery code can reset it. It takes a minute: you'll need your secret code and something to write on.
reminder.bodyOldAndroid: On this version of Android, Saakshi can't ask for the screen lock alone (without a fingerprint or face). If you forget your secret code, only a recovery code can reset it. It takes a minute: you'll need your secret code and something to write on.
